topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumbled upon a time capsule today, right in my own backyard, under the old oak tree. The contents are a mystery wrapped in nostalgia, pictures and trinkets from a time I thought I had left behind. It’s strange, finding something so personal that I cannot for the life of me recall burying. Each item inside seems to whisper secrets, echoes of decisions made too quickly, too lightly, perhaps. I keep the capsule close, as if by holding it, I can somehow make right the things that slipped through my fingers, unacknowledged and unkept. The afternoon wears on, and I find myself standing by the tree, tracing the patterns in the bark, wondering how many other things I've forgotten to remember.
